targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_requests), 1) as avg_requests FROM user_sessions WHERE total_requests >= 2 AND (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) AND user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM conversations WHERE message_type = 'chat')
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_requests), 1) as avg_requests FROM user_sessions WHERE total_requests >= 2 AND (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) AND user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM conversations WHERE message_type = 'chat')

SELECT ROUND(AVG(real_conv), 1) as avg FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as real_conv FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.user_query != '' AND c.is_preset = 0 AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) AND c.user_id != 'anonymous_user' GROUP BY c.user_id HAVING real_conv >= 2)

SELECT real_conv as median FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as real_conv FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.user_query != '' AND c.is_preset = 0 AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) AND c.user_id != 'anonymous_user' GROUP BY c.user_id HAVING real_conv >= 2 ORDER BY real_conv) LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.user_id FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.user_query != '' AND c.is_preset = 0 AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) AND c.user_id != 'anonymous_user' GROUP BY c.user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)) / 2

panels.title: 📈 核心指标趋势 Daily Trends

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%s', day) as time, SUM(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY day) as value FROM (SELECT date(first_seen) as day, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM user_sessions WHERE total_requests >= 2 AND (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) AND user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM conversations WHERE message_type = 'chat') GROUP BY day) ORDER BY day

SELECT strftime('%s', day) as time, AVG(avg_time) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as value FROM (SELECT date(first_seen) as day, ROUND(AVG(total_play_seconds / 60.0), 1) as avg_time FROM user_sessions WHERE total_requests >= 2 AND (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) AND user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM conversations WHERE message_type = 'chat') GROUP BY day) ORDER BY day

SELECT strftime('%s', day) as time, AVG(avg_req) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as value FROM (SELECT date(first_seen) as day, ROUND(AVG(total_requests), 1) as avg_req FROM user_sessions WHERE total_requests >= 2 AND (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) AND user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM conversations WHERE message_type = 'chat') GROUP BY day) ORDER BY day

SELECT strftime('%s', day) as time, AVG(avg_conv) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as value FROM (SELECT day, ROUND(AVG(daily_conv), 1) as avg_conv FROM (SELECT date(c.timestamp) as day, c.user_id, COUNT(*) as daily_conv FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.user_query != '' AND c.is_preset = 0 AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) AND c.user_id != 'anonymous_user' GROUP BY day, c.user_id HAVING daily_conv >= 2) GROUP BY day) ORDER BY day

SELECT strftime('%s', day) as time, SUM(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY day) as value FROM (SELECT date(c.timestamp) as day, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.user_query != '' AND c.is_preset = 0 AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) AND c.user_id != 'anonymous_user' GROUP BY day) ORDER BY day

SELECT strftime('%s', day) as time, SUM(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY day) as value FROM (SELECT date(c.timestamp) as day, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) as cnt FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.message_type = 'chat' AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) AND c.user_id != 'anonymous_user' GROUP BY day) ORDER BY day
